justify_why_units_are_missing.justification: The x-axis shows bins of Pol II enrichment (visualized as a triangular gradient) but the plot image does not include numeric axis ticks or an explicit unit label. The underlying variable is continuous (Pol II ChIP-seq signal) but the axis itself lacks an on-figure unit annotation.
